Provider: openrouter (gemini + openai). reviews_succeeded=2, degraded=false. Overall: ship-with-fixes.
Four findings, ALL fixed in this same diff:
1. [bug, MEDIUM, pty-manager.ts forceRedraw catch] `(err as Error).message` is unsafe: JS permits `throw null`, where the property read throws again and ESCAPES the catch, out through the WS message handler — breaking the AC-3 swallowing guarantee. FIXED: `err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)`.
2. [test, LOW, pty-manager.force-redraw.test.ts] The AC-3 test only threw an Error, so it would have passed despite finding 1. FIXED: parameterised over Error / null / bare string / plain object (4 cases).
3. [test, LOW, useTerminalSizeSync.test.ts] The reader case asserted only "no redraw", so it would have passed if a reader wrongly emitted a resize (reflowing the snapshot width, #150). FIXED: assert `send` was not called at all.
4. [test, gemini] The E2E ordering assertion `expect(types.indexOf("redraw")).toBeGreaterThan(types.indexOf("resize"))` is VACUOUSLY TRUE when "resize" is absent (indexOf returns -1), hiding a missing convergence resize. FIXED: assert `types` toContain("resize") first. Re-ran the spec against the isolated stack after the change: PASS.
